text:
Maria (Finance): Heads up — partner rebate invoices from the new reseller cutover are blocked in Stripe and held for manual review. Month-end close in 2 business days. Do we accrue the rebate liability or defer revenue until invoices clear?

Sophia (Billing): We flagged ~120 invoices with tag `reseller_cutover_hold`. Example invoice: `INV-2026-0893` lines show a -$12,500 rebate memo and a hosted-usage line. Bot pulled them into a hold queue.

Leo (RevRec): For rebates that reduce consideration, typically we record an accrued liability against revenue (contra-revenue) if the rebate amount is probable and estimable. If billing is uncertain and collectability on partner side is unknown, we might put a deferral until resolution. Need $ estimate.

Maria (Finance): Preliminary agg: gross billings $1,250,000, estimated rebate exposure $47,200 (based on contract SOW). I can push a provisional journal if we decide to accrue.

Andrew (Controller): @Leo can you suggest the JE? Also need GL map and memo for auditors. If we accrue: Dr Revenue deduction (4002) $47,200, Cr Accrued rebates (2405) $47,200. If we defer: Dr Accounts receivable (1100) $47,200, Cr Deferred revenue (2100) $47,200. Thoughts?

Leo (RevRec): I agree with Andrew's mapping. Prefer accrue contra-revenue when rebate is a contractual obligation and can be estimated. Add a separate audit memo: calculation, contract references, and list of invoices on hold.

Sophia (Billing): Quick snippet of hold query we ran:
```
select invoice_id, partner_id, amount, hold_reason
from invoices
where metadata->>'hold_tag' = 'reseller_cutover_hold';
```
We can export CSV with the 120 rows by EOD.

Maria (Finance): Ok — action plan: 1) Sophia to export CSV + confirm contract SOW lines for the 3 largest partners (by EOD). 2) Leo & I prepare an accrual calc and draft JE. 3) Andrew sign-off in the close deck. 4) If partner dispute emerges we move to deferral template.

Andrew (Controller): Sounds good. For the close deck include: accrual amount, rounding/methodology, sample invoices, and controls over subsequent reversal. I'll sign if backup looks solid.

revenue-bot: reminder — month-end close checklist: 'post accruals' task due in 24h. Link: https://redwood.internal/close/tasks/119

Sophia (Billing): CSV export queued. I flagged top-3 partners in the sheet. Attaching sample rows in the export channel in 10m.

Maria (Finance): Thanks — once I get CSV Leo, can you draft the memo and JE text here so I can paste into the close request?

Leo (RevRec): Yep. I'll draft JE + short memo after I review the CSV. Expect first pass in ~2 hours. :clock2: 

Andrew (Controller): If anyone needs me to approve pre-close accruals earlier, ping me directly. :+1:

Maria (Finance): Great. Marking this as "accrue unless material disputes show up" for now. Will update thread after Leo's memo.

Sophia (Billing): sample CSV column headers: `invoice_id, partner_name, partner_contract_id, billed_amount, rebate_amount, hold_reason, created_at`. Will upload now.

Leo (RevRec): uploaded memo draft v0.1 to the close folder: /finance/close/2026-03/rebate-accrual-memo-v0.1.docx. Key points: basis for estimate, % methodology, and recommended JE.

Maria (Finance): Got it. Reviewing now. If approved I'll create the accrual journal in NetSuite and tag it `MO-ACCRUAL-2026-03-REBAT` for traceability.

Andrew (Controller): Perfect. Keep thread updated with final JE number and post-close reversal plan.

Maria (Finance): Will do. Thanks team.
